# ===================================================================
# GOOD MODIFIER EXAMPLES
# ===================================================================
# This file demonstrates CORRECT CK3 modifier definitions.
# All examples in this file should PASS validation with NO errors.
#
# What this tests:
# - Standard character modifiers with numeric stat bonuses
# - Opinion modifiers with required fields
# - Timed modifiers
# - Complex modifiers with multiple stats
#
# File scope note: The modifier validator only runs on files
# whose path contains "modifier" or "opinion_modifier".
#
# Expected validation result: NO ERRORS
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 1: Standard character modifier with numeric stat bonuses
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Basic modifier with known keys and numeric values
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - all keys are known, all values are numeric
# DEMONSTRATES: Simple modifier definition
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
good_character_modifier = {
	diplomacy = 2
	martial = 1
	stewardship = 3
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 2: Opinion modifier with all fields
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Opinion modifier with opinion, years, and decaying
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - opinion field present and in range
# DEMONSTRATES: Complete opinion modifier definition
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
good_opinion_modifier = {
	opinion = -25
	years = 5
	decaying = yes
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 3: Timed modifier with icon
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Modifier with duration-related fields
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - all known keys, numeric values
# DEMONSTRATES: Timed modifier pattern
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
good_timed_modifier = {
	diplomacy = 5
	monthly_prestige = 0.5
	years = 10
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 4: Complex modifier with multiple stat bonuses
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Modifier using many different stat keys
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - all keys recognized, all values numeric or yes/no
# DEMONSTRATES: Multi-stat modifier with boolean and numeric values
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
good_complex_modifier = {
	diplomacy = 3
	martial = 2
	stewardship = 1
	intrigue = 4
	learning = 2
	prowess = 5
	monthly_prestige = 1.0
	monthly_piety = 0.5
	fertility = 0.1
	health = 0.5
	same_opinion = 10
	opposite_opinion = -5
	attraction_opinion = 15
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Example 5: Opinion modifier at reasonable boundary values
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# WHAT THIS TESTS: Opinion values at edges of typical range
# SHOULD PASS: Yes - values within -200 to 200
# DEMONSTRATES: Boundary-safe opinion modifiers
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
good_strong_positive_opinion = {
	opinion = 200
	years = 20
	decaying = yes
}

good_strong_negative_opinion = {
	opinion = -200
	years = 15
	decaying = no
}
